EC1: patients who do not wish to participate in the project;
EC3: patients with comorbidities (heart failure congestive [OR], chronic obstructive pulmonary disease);
EC6: patients with infected miscarriage [OR]/abortion (presence of fever [OR], pus from the cervix [OR], leukocytosis [> 14000]);
